description: This file contains shell script tests for the 'git worktree add' command, including setup, various usage scenarios, error conditions, hooks, and configuration options.

methods.name: test_dwim_orphan
methods.description: Function to test various scenarios of 'DWIM' (Do What I Mean) behavior when creating orphan worktrees, including different options and error conditions.

methods.name: setup_remote_repo
methods.description: Function to initialize remote repositories with branches and commits for testing remote worktree add scenarios.

methods.name: post_checkout_hook
methods.description: Sets up a post-checkout hook script in a given repository or worktree to verify hook invocation during worktree addition.

methods.name: test_branch_upstream
methods.description: Verifies that a branch in a worktree is correctly set to track a remote branch.
